answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ripple of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. A walnut of per-task receipts records who did what, and the umber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
